Game Overview

In Mission Kill Italian Brainrot, the core idea is straightforward: join Tung Tung on a relentless quest against waves of enemies. Navigate challenging levels, discover hidden chests, and amass treasure. Upgrade your arsenal as adversaries grow tougher. Can you conquer the chaos and emerge victorious?
